name: last-block-rank8-lora-vicreg-participation
purpose: Test the final authorized backbone-participation factor by extending the exact replicated C1 VICReg mechanism into rank-8 LoRA adapters on the final DINOv2-S/14 block.
hypothesis: Allowing only the last frozen DINO block's four Linear modules to participate through rank-8 LoRA in fold-local VICReg improves provenance-held-out pooled OOF top-1 beyond a same-process exact C1 replay.
symmetric_risk: The instrument is noisy and repeatedly consulted; LoRA may preserve or degrade C1. Any result below supported_reference retires the instrument without v18.4.
claim_domain: pooled OOF top-1 only; macro, top-3, support, bootstrap, movement, loss, rank, and control-replay outputs are mandatory diagnostics

arms.mission_anchor: Persisted B0 top-k rows from v9, used only for the unchanged mission anchor.
arms.paired_control: C1 re-executed in the same process from fold-train features reconstructed through the shared pre-final-block token cache at zero LoRA. Every persisted C1 train state and plan must match before active LoRA training; its top-k must match after the physically sealed OOF cache is created and before candidate interpretation.
arms.candidate: The same C1 initialization, view plan, VICReg projection and expander, supervised episode plan, and budgets, with only rank-8 LoRA matrices added to the final DINO block during VICReg and then frozen for the unchanged supervised readout.

changed_factor.only_change: final DINOv2-S/14 block participates in C1 VICReg through LoRA
changed_factor.base_weights_and_biases: frozen with byte hashes before and after every fold-by-seed run
forbidden: rank, alpha, placement, learning-rate, weight-decay, epoch, batch-size, or loss sweep
head or projection factor from v18.1/v18.2
early stopping or selection from OOF
retry, fallback, distillation, ensemble, or second candidate

shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.preprocessing: exact v9 resize_and_pad, image_tensor, and safe_ssl_view code and operations
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.train_storage: per-fold numpy .npy memmap shaped [train_rows,9,257,384], base then views 0..7
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.oof_storage: physically separate per-fold numpy .npy memmap shaped [oof_rows,1,257,384], base only
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.oof_creation: only after every VICReg and supervised update for all three seeds of the fold is complete
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.backbone_compute: CUDA autocast float16 exactly as v9; block input/output, norm output, and CLS feature remain float32
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.persisted_feature_boundary: quantize reconstructed CLS float32 to float16 exactly as v9, then convert to float32 for projection, expander, VICReg, supervised readout, and prediction
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.train_resume_batch_policy: group selected tokens by their original flattened extraction batch size; nominal 144 and the fold-specific final partial size; deterministic repeat-last padding to that exact size then unpad
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.oof_resume_batch_policy: group tokens by original base-only extraction batch size; nominal 16 and the fold-specific final partial size; deterministic repeat-last padding to that exact size then unpad
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.feature_equivalence_gate: all 359640 train base/view features and all 653 OOF base features must be byte-identical to canonical v9 float16 tensors
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.actual_cache_hash_sealing: spec/evaluator/schema freeze before extraction; each generated train or OOF cache and metadata hash is sealed in an execution manifest before downstream use
shared_token_cache_and_numeric_policy.replay: reuse hash-verified train and OOF token caches; never re-extract

vicreg_phase.projection: exact C1 ProjectionHead 384→384→128 initialized from the same global RNG state
vicreg_phase.expander: exact C1 VICRegExpander initialized from the same global RNG state

gradient_clipping.interpretation: the larger clipping union is an intrinsic declared consequence of LoRA participation

supervised_phase.projection_initial_state: the projection returned by the corresponding VICReg arm

stop_rule: Any control-path mismatch aborts before active LoRA training. Any result below supported_reference, integrity failure, or replay mismatch permanently retires this instrument with no v18.4.
